title: Saesee Tiin
subtitle: Jedi
franchise: Star Wars: Attack of the Clones
description: Saesee Tiin was an imposing Ikotchi and member of the Jedi Council during the final years of the Jedi Order. He was a skilled and courageous Lightsaber wielder and an accomplished starfighter pilot. He made the trip to naboo to attend the funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn and served as a battlefield general for the Jedi during the Clone Wars.
